description:
The Sims 2 - Needs Translation - Batch20
Note for translators: This is a "life potion" -- if successful it pushes back the current age transition so the Sim will be in the current age longer. If unsuccessful it makes the current age or time for death quicker.
reason: Player screenshot 2026-10-09 proves Elixir of Life is visible in Castaway aspiration rewards. This exact CTSS owner, distinct from already covered Elixir of Life Potion, must be translated together with its description.

en: Perfect for those who like their idle water-cooler chats to go on for ages . . . literally! Gather round this decorative glass urn and sip the sweet nectar of prolonged youth as your Sim resists aging.
